Contract:
Live coverage map, shown to the operator compactly before every round. Topic labels in Russian; ≤ 72 columns; statuses per `BREADCRUMB_FORMAT` — `✅` closed · `👷` in progress (the topic this round is closing) · `◻️` open — plus one map-only extension, `✗ skip: <причина>`, for a topic the operator explicitly waived.
Покрытие: Цель/не-цель ✅ · Потребители 👷 · Слабые места ◻️ · Зависимости ◻️ Усиления: security 👷 · storage ✗ skip: прототип, данных нет
4–6 topics per line; the «Усиления» line appears only when at least one amplification is active or skipped. The map is session state for the dialogue — the calling step decides what from the answers lands in the artifact; the map itself stays out of the spec.
